content: How much protein should I eat to build muscle?

Aim for about 1.6–2.2 g of protein per kg of body weight per day. Going above that doesn't add much. Spread it over 3–5 meals, with roughly 20–40 g each.

💡 For a 3-month bench goal, eat enough total calories as well. A small surplus of about 200–300 kcal gives your muscles the energy to grow.

If you tell me your body weight, I'll work out your daily target.
